rationale: Archive Neoen S.A. from the North American manager-level PortCo list while preserving its company, ownership and audit history. Neoen is a global French-origin renewable-power platform, and its Canada and Mexico operations are a minority subset of the company rather than a North America-dedicated operating perimeter.

evidence.purpose: Current ownership, global company scope, geographic mix and later-event evidence.
